summary: Copies a 0x18-byte (3 doubles) inertia-tensor diagonal region from a2 into this+188, then writes the reciprocals 1.0 / a2[0..2] into this+0xD4/0xDC/0xE4 (each using the 1.0 base constant dbl_59E420), then calls InertiaTensorWorldSpaceTransform(this) to refresh the world-space transform. Unconditional: no guards. Called by SuspensionSetupSectionReader, PhysicsCollisionDamageDNFDetection, VehiclePhysicsInitializer, sub_43C250 and CollisionInvMassStore.

local_names.this: owner object receiving the inertia diagonal copy and reciprocals
local_names.a2: source array of 3 doubles (inertia tensor diagonal components)

operations.description: qmemcpy copies 0x18 bytes (3 doubles) from a2 into this+188, staging the raw inertia diagonal values before reciprocal computation
Writes 1.0 / a2[0] into this+0xD4; the 1.0 numerator comes from the base double constant dbl_59E420
Writes 1.0 / a2[1] into this+0xDC; the 1.0 numerator comes from the base double constant dbl_59E420
Writes 1.0 / a2[2] into this+0xE4; the 1.0 numerator comes from the base double constant dbl_59E420
Calls InertiaTensorWorldSpaceTransform(this) to transform the updated inertia into world space after the diagonal values are set

Returns void to its callers SuspensionSetupSectionReader (00435410), PhysicsCollisionDamageDNFDetection (00438690), VehiclePhysicsInitializer (00439210), sub_43C250 (0043C250) and CollisionInvMassStore (00459950)
